metadata.name: HANZO Network LED Dots
metadata.description: Animated (flicker) ASCII art in the Dots style, made with the 21st ASCII editor and baked to a looping video. Styled with a neon, pixel look. A drop-in, zero-dependency React component for hero sections, cards, and retro terminal-style backgrounds.
